name: SKULL SMASH
desc: Stand tall and aim high, leap and smash down. Lands on the head. Unblockable while the smash is charged.

name: HIGH OVERHEAD
desc: Stand tall and aim high, bring the blade over the top. Lands on the head.

name: HEAD CUT
desc: Stand tall and aim high, cut straight through. Lands on the head.

name: HIGH SWEEP
desc: Stand tall and aim high, sweep the blade low. Lands on the head.

name: HIGH KICK
desc: Stand tall and aim high, drive a kick in. Lands on the head.

name: LOW GUARD STANCE
desc: Hold your ground standing tall with the blade held low: covers the legs and body while closing in.

name: GUARD STANCE
desc: Hold your ground standing tall with the blade held ready: covers the body while closing in.

name: HIGH GUARD STANCE
desc: Hold your ground standing tall with the blade held high: covers the head and body while closing in.

name: RISING SMASH
desc: Spring in and rise, leap and smash down. Lands on the head.

name: RISING OVERHEAD
desc: Spring in and rise, bring the blade over the top. Lands on the head.

name: RISING SLASH
desc: Spring in and rise, cut straight through. Lands on the head.

name: RISING SWEEP
desc: Spring in and rise, sweep the blade low. Lands on the head.

name: RISING KICK
desc: Spring in and rise, drive a kick in. Lands on the head.

name: LOW GUARD HOP IN
desc: Hop in with the blade held low: covers the legs and body while closing in.

name: GUARD HOP IN
desc: Hop in with the blade held ready: covers the body while closing in.

name: HIGH GUARD HOP IN
desc: Hop in with the blade held high: covers the head and body while closing in.

name: LUNGE SMASH
desc: Lunge in, leap and smash down. Lands on the body.

name: LUNGE OVERHEAD
desc: Lunge in, bring the blade over the top. Lands on the body.

name: LUNGE SLASH
desc: Lunge in, cut straight through. Lands on the body.

name: LUNGE SWEEP
desc: Lunge in, sweep the blade low. Lands on the body.

name: LUNGE KICK
desc: Lunge in, drive a kick in. Lands on the body.

name: LOW GUARD ADVANCE
desc: Press forward with the blade held low: covers the legs and body while closing in.

name: GUARD ADVANCE
desc: Press forward with the blade held ready: covers the body while closing in.

name: HIGH GUARD ADVANCE
desc: Press forward with the blade held high: covers the head and body while closing in.

name: DIVING SMASH
desc: Dive in low, leap and smash down. Lands on the legs.

name: DIVING OVERHEAD
desc: Dive in low, bring the blade over the top. Lands on the legs.

name: DIVING SLASH
desc: Dive in low, cut straight through. Lands on the legs.

name: DIVING SWEEP
desc: Dive in low, sweep the blade low. Lands on the legs.

name: DIVING KICK
desc: Dive in low, drive a kick in. Lands on the legs.

name: LOW GUARD SLIDE IN
desc: Slide in low with the blade held low: covers the legs and body while closing in.

name: GUARD SLIDE IN
desc: Slide in low with the blade held ready: covers the body while closing in.

name: HIGH GUARD SLIDE IN
desc: Slide in low with the blade held high: covers the head and body while closing in.

name: STOMP
desc: Drop low, leap and smash down. Lands on the legs.

name: LOW OVERHEAD
desc: Drop low, bring the blade over the top. Lands on the legs.

name: LOW SLASH
desc: Drop low, cut straight through. Lands on the legs.

name: LOW SWEEP
desc: Drop low, sweep the blade low. Lands on the legs.

name: LOW KICK
desc: Drop low, drive a kick in. Lands on the legs.

name: LOW GUARD CROUCH
desc: Hold your ground in a crouch with the blade held low: covers the legs and body while closing in.

name: GUARD CROUCH
desc: Hold your ground in a crouch with the blade held ready: covers the body while closing in.

name: HIGH GUARD CROUCH
desc: Hold your ground in a crouch with the blade held high: covers the head and body while closing in.

name: CROUCH HIGH BLOCK
desc: Crouch away and raise the guard high. Turns blows to the head and body for a quarter of the damage.

name: CROUCH HIGH PARRY
desc: Crouch away and raise the guard high. A parry: it covers only the head but takes no damage and staggers the attacker.

name: CROUCH MID BLOCK
desc: Crouch away and raise the guard level. Turns blows to the body for a quarter of the damage.

name: CROUCH LOW PARRY
desc: Crouch away and raise the guard low. A parry: it covers only the legs but takes no damage and staggers the attacker.

name: CROUCH LOW BLOCK
desc: Crouch away and raise the guard low. Turns blows to the legs and body for a quarter of the damage.

name: LOW SLIDE BACK
desc: Slide back low away from the enemy. The blade is held low: blows to the legs and body do half damage.

name: SLIDE BACK
desc: Slide back low away from the enemy.

name: HIGH SLIDE BACK
desc: Slide back low away from the enemy. The blade is held high: blows to the head and body do half damage.

name: HIGH BLOCK
desc: Lean away and raise the guard high. Turns blows to the head and body for a quarter of the damage.

name: HIGH PARRY
desc: Lean away and raise the guard high. A parry: it covers only the head but takes no damage and staggers the attacker.

name: MID BLOCK
desc: Lean away and raise the guard level. Turns blows to the body for a quarter of the damage.

name: LOW PARRY
desc: Lean away and raise the guard low. A parry: it covers only the legs but takes no damage and staggers the attacker.

name: LOW BLOCK
desc: Lean away and raise the guard low. Turns blows to the legs and body for a quarter of the damage.

name: LOW STEP BACK
desc: Step back away from the enemy. The blade is held low: blows to the legs and body do half damage.

name: STEP BACK
desc: Step back away from the enemy.

name: HIGH STEP BACK
desc: Step back away from the enemy. The blade is held high: blows to the head and body do half damage.

name: SWAY HIGH BLOCK
desc: Sway back, standing tall, and raise the guard high. Turns blows to the head and body for a quarter of the damage.

name: SWAY HIGH PARRY
desc: Sway back, standing tall, and raise the guard high. A parry: it covers only the head but takes no damage and staggers the attacker.

name: SWAY MID BLOCK
desc: Sway back, standing tall, and raise the guard level. Turns blows to the body for a quarter of the damage.

name: SWAY LOW PARRY
desc: Sway back, standing tall, and raise the guard low. A parry: it covers only the legs but takes no damage and staggers the attacker.

name: SWAY LOW BLOCK
desc: Sway back, standing tall, and raise the guard low. Turns blows to the legs and body for a quarter of the damage.

name: LOW HOP BACK
desc: Hop back away from the enemy. The blade is held low: blows to the legs and body do half damage.

name: HOP BACK
desc: Hop back away from the enemy.

name: HIGH HOP BACK
desc: Hop back away from the enemy. The blade is held high: blows to the head and body do half damage.
